correctness.rationale: Exact rational boundary ranks of the 1090-face complex are 15,81,191,181,58,14,2, giving rational Betti ranks four and one. Full chain-equivariance verifies all 96 automorphisms. Degree-four action is calculated on nonboundary cycles modulo both 101 and 103 with unchanged boundary ranks, yielding the exact bipartition sign. Complete signed Lefschetz traces produce the thirteen-class degree-three character. Character inner products are 1 for lambda and 2 for chi3 with itself, proving a rational 1+3 decomposition with absolutely irreducible three-dimensional complement. Averaged invariant traces prove all three rational quotient cohomology rings. The standalone checker runs successfully and produces the recorded output.

value.rationale: The canonical 16-vertex cubic symmetric graph has mixed-dimensional independence homology; its complete action under 96 automorphisms distinguishes two inequivalent linear characters and a three-dimensional absolutely irreducible module. The two natural normal index-two quotients separately retain degree-three and degree-four rational cohomology, while the full quotient loses both. This is an action-sensitive structural invariant and is not implied by the existing ordinary sphere-wedge type or eight-element cyclic restriction.
